data.question: How much of the fixed 22-author WEF Data Equity roster can be institutionally resolved without backdating current roles?
data.method: Continue exact-name WEF person and agenda-contributor searches and classify role timing conservatively.
data.scope: Second tranche of named authors from the arXiv roster.
findings: Alberto Giovanni Busetto's current WEF profile identifies him as Founder and Managing Partner of Oⁿ Venture Studio and preserves prior senior Data & AI roles at Adecco and Merck; publication-era employer still requires exact dating.

Astha Kapoor's WEF agenda-contributor page identifies her as Co-Founder of Aapti Institute and includes a WEF article dated April 2023 under that role, supporting Aapti as a publication-era affiliation.
Zheng Lei's WEF profile identifies him as Professor at Fudan University and Director of its Lab for Digital and Mobile Governance.
Jacqueline Lu's WEF agenda-contributor page identifies her as CEO and Founder of Helpful Places and preserves her prior Mozilla Foundation and Sidewalk Labs roles.
Emna Mizouni's WEF profile identifies her as Founder-CEO of Digital Citizenship and a member of the Global Future Council on Data Equity following earlier Tech & Human Rights council service.

María Paz Canales Loebel's current WEF profile identifies her as Head of Legal, Policy and Research at Global Partners Digital and preserves her earlier Executive Director role at Derechos Digitales beginning in 2017; exact October 2023 transition timing remains to be pinned down.

Angela Oduor Lungati's WEF contributor page identifies her as Executive Director of Ushahidi and states she formerly served on the Data Equity council; WEF separately lists her on the current Data Frontiers council.
The pass preserves David Kanamugire and other still-unresolved authors rather than assigning organizations from weak snippets or secondary sources.
conclusions: The author network is increasingly source-resolved as a cross-sector professional graph, but publication-era dates remain a separate data-quality dimension from identity resolution.
limitations: Not every WEF person page exposes historical-role dates sufficient for an exact October 2023 affiliation assertion.
